scope: Synthetic rendered scenes only; offline perception, no camera-driven motion.
assumptions: Horizontal table tools with varied yaw
Known static camera calibration and metric axial depth
Known workbench volume; no nominal tool coordinates

pilot.scope: Rendered RGB + metric axial depth + known calibration/catalog; no simulator-state inputs.

heldout.scope: Rendered RGB + metric axial depth + known calibration/catalog; no simulator-state inputs.

pipeline.scope: 30 sequential captures of one stationary physics scene; no motion, IPC or disk IO.

limitations: Occlusion case002 also withholds wrench as ambiguous
Not semantic recognition of arbitrary real tools
Fit score is not a calibrated probability
No actuation or hardware readiness claim

probe_failure.scope: Analytic verifier arithmetic, not physical failure
